all_na_strategy_exit.source_calls: Unconditional strategy.exit for Long and Short, passing both limit and stop series; both are na when source-default useTP=false and useSL=false.
all_na_strategy_exit.verified_documentation: V5 reference describes price-based TP/SL orders and the v5 migration guide requires price-defining parameters or a complete trailing pair. The source supplies named limit and stop parameters, but these evaluate to na at the disabled defaults.
all_na_strategy_exit.not_established: Neither inspected primary reference nor migration text directly establishes runtime behavior when all supplied exit price series are na. It does not prove native no-op, native success, or native failure for this source.
all_na_strategy_exit.declared_mathematical_adapter: Explicitly treat absent stop/limit prices as creating no price orders. This models the published disabled protection intention; it is an adapter declaration, not verified unchanged native execution.
forbidden_silent_repairs: Replace absent barriers with invented prices
Claim native runtime parity from mathematical fixtures

ema10.reference_locator: Core bundle ta.ema entry: documented equivalent pine_ema example; description78869 and remark309834.
ema10.documented_equivalent_on_valid_closes: First valid close initializes EMA; later EMA_t=(2/11)*close_t+(9/11)*EMA_(t-1).
ema10.seed: First valid close, not a 10-bar SMA
ema10.missing_values: The reference says source na values are ignored; any segment admission policy must separately prevent bridging missing market observations.
ema10.parity_boundary: Documented reference-equivalent recurrence is established. Native engine execution was not performed. Segment resets, 240-bar admission warmup, and 8h selection are harness declarations, not source parameters.

candle_geometry.interpretation: Bullish upper shadow and bearish lower shadow are constrained to 5% of total range. Body is not the denominator and the opposite wick is unrestricted.
candle_geometry.zero_range: Undefined division/na; source has no guard. Strict bullish and bearish predicates also fail on a flat candle. Do not coerce shadow_percent to zero or invent a symmetric wick filter.

clock_and_entry_capture.market_order_fill: Default earliest next available tick, ordinarily next historical bar open; no source on-close fill request.
clock_and_entry_capture.causal_long_timing: On the first fillbar close calculation after a new long fills at that bar's open, capture that fillbar raw open. Do not capture on signalclose or before the fill is observed.
clock_and_entry_capture.capture_cases: Flat-to-long and short-to-long size increases qualify if exactly one trade is open; flat-to-short and long-to-short do not. The last captured long reference persists after closing; before the first capture it is na.
clock_and_entry_capture.slippage_boundary: Long exit compares raw fillbar open even when a declared execution model shifts actual fill. Substituting actual fill changes the published long rule.

sizing.source: Initial capital1000 USD, percent_of_equity10, no explicit qty, commission0.1% per transaction.
sizing.documented_timing: Strategy Properties specifies percentage of available equity when a trade opens; v5 percent_of_equity reference835364 applies when entry qty is omitted.
sizing.mathematical_target: At a new flat-to-long opening fill, target quote notional is 0.10*available strategy equity at opening, converted to units using the opening fill price under the declared port.
sizing.cash_constraint: A Spot port must explicitly define fee-reserved available cash, lot rounding, minimum size, price reference and rejected orders. Fees are booked once on both entry and exit. These details are not supplied by the Pine source.
sizing.not_native_parity: A signalclose-fixed quantity, USD-to-USDT conversion, synthetic costs, and exchange sizing restrictions are declared deviations or accounting choices, not verified native percent-equity parity.

pyramiding_priority_and_reversal.native_reversal: Opposite strategy.entry normally transacts current position close plus newly requested opposite size; published showLong and showShort are both true.
pyramiding_priority_and_reversal.signal_overlap: Bullish long-entry and bearish short-entry geometry cannot both occur on the same bar. While already long, same-direction entry is suppressed and a qualifying long close can still issue. A close call addresses matching open entry trades and is not a documented pending-entry cancellation.
pyramiding_priority_and_reversal.priority_boundary: General examples of market closes preceding brackets do not prove every samebar collision. Exact native call/collision behavior requires a native fixture; none was executed.
pyramiding_priority_and_reversal.proposed_spot_declaration: Long-only Spot: published short-entry geometry closes an existing long to cash, without opening a short. This is an explicit reversal adaptation. Preserve the source long exit and disabled price protection. Freeze priority before market evaluation.
synthetic_fixture_scope: Flat entry plus stale exit reference
pyramiding_priority_and_reversal.fixture_limit: Synthetic mathematical tests verify the declared port, not TradingView native runtime.
